note: Sourced facts for fact cards. Each 'fit' lists what must be visible in a clip for the fact to be about it.

facts.fact: The Last of Us Part II has more than 60 accessibility settings, including completely new features for low-vision and blind players.
facts.quote: PlayStation Blog: "The Last of Us Part II features more than 60 accessibility settings, with expanded options focused on fine-motor and hearing, as well as completely new features that benefit low-vision and blind players."

facts.fact: The High Contrast Display mode mutes the colours of the world and adds distinct contrast colouring to allies, enemies, items and interactive objects.
facts.quote: PlayStation Blog: "Mutes environment colors and adds distinct contrast coloring to allies, enemies, items, and interactive objects."

facts.fact: With Enhanced Listen Mode on, a scan triggers audio cues at the target's location, and the pitch changes based on the target's height relative to you.
facts.quote: PlayStation Blog: "Send out a scan triggering audio cues at the target's location. The pitch of the sound changes based on the target's height relative to you."

facts.fact: An accessibility option called Invisible While Prone makes you invisible to enemies while you are prone and not aiming. It is disabled in certain encounters where stealth is not an option.
facts.quote: PlayStation Blog: "You are invisible to enemies while prone and not aiming. This setting is disabled during certain encounters where stealth is not an option."

facts.fact: The guitar shows a circle on screen divided into six notes. You point a stick at a chord, then swipe the touchpad to strum, or tap it to pluck single strings.
facts.quote: Screen Rant: "they will be presented with a circle on-screen divided into six different notes."

facts.fact: Naughty Dog built the first guitar prototype from motion capture of Ellie actress Ashley Johnson singing Take on Me.
facts.quote: TheGamer: "This way of thinking led the team to create a prototype for the guitar from the captured cinematics of Ellie actress Ashley Johnson singing Take on Me."

facts.fact: In the Remastered version, the very first cutscene shows Joel cleaning a guitar's frets, and the DualSense vibrates from left to right as his hand moves along the neck.
facts.flag: Single source (Engadget). Remastered on PS5 only.
facts.quote: Engadget: "The game's very first cut scene shows Part I protagonist Joel cleaning the frets on a guitar, and you can feel slight vibrations from left to right as his hand moves across the guitar neck."

facts.fact: Ellie leaves a scent trail that fades over time, and if a dog picks it up, it can find her wherever she is hiding, in a way a human enemy cannot.
facts.quote: PlayStation Blog: "as Ellie moves around she leaves behind this [scent] trail that fades over time, but if the dog picks up the trailer he can find you wherever you're hiding in a way that a human on their own can't."

facts.fact: Listen Mode shows your scent, so you can see whether a dog is sniffing you out, and you can throw bottles to distract it off your scent.
facts.quote: GamesRadar: "You can see if the dog is sniffing you and where it's going, you can throw bottles to distract the dog off of your scent."

facts.fact: Every human enemy in the game has a unique name, such as Omar or Joe, which Naughty Dog says needed new tech and a lot of recording.
facts.quote: PlayStation Blog: "One example is that every human enemy in the game features a unique name, such as Omar, or Joe."

facts.fact: The Seraphites talk to each other with whistles, so they can coordinate without showing the player exactly what they are doing.
facts.flag: Single source (GamesRadar, quoting co-game director Anthony Newman).
facts.quote: GamesRadar: "the way that they communicate with each other with the whistles, they're able to coordinate with each other without revealing to the player exactly what they're doing."

facts.fact: The Shambler is a new infected type in Part II. It gives off a cloud of gaseous acid that burns the things around it and burns your skin.
facts.quote: PlayStation Blog: "Shamblers provide this area of attack, where they have this cloud of gaseous acid that burns materials around it. It burns your skin."

facts.fact: Stalkers like to peek around corners and spot you before they attack.
facts.quote: Screen Rant: "Stalkers like to peek around and spot players before they attack."

facts.fact: Setting a Clicker on fire with a Molotov makes it scream, which can draw other enemies in and set them all on fire at once.
facts.quote: TheGamer: "throwing a Molotov cocktail at the Clicker will set it on fire causing it to scream. This will then draw in the other enemies setting them all on fire at once."

facts.fact: Burning a Bloater can strip the armour-like layer covering its skin, leaving it more open to rifles and shotguns.
facts.quote: TheGamer: "Burning it should remove the layer of armor that's covering its skin and make the disgusting blob more vulnerable to weapons like rifles and shotguns."

facts.fact: Ellie can crawl through small gaps that the developers call squeeze-throughs, which gives her new ways to sneak around.
facts.quote: GamesRadar: "Ellie can squeeze through "squeeze-throughs" as they're called by Margenau."

facts.fact: In close fights you can evade, trade combos and slam enemies into objects.
facts.quote: GamesRadar: "You'll be able to evade, exchange combos, and slam each other into objects."

facts.fact: A rising whooshing sound means an enemy is noticing you but has not seen you yet. The faster and louder it rises, the more exposed you are.
facts.quote: GamesRadar: "An ominous whooshing noise building up means someone is noticing you but hasn't 'seen' you yet."

facts.fact: There are eight training manuals to find, and each one unlocks a new upgrade branch, or skill tree.
facts.quote: GamesRadar: "There are a total of eight to track down across the game, and locating these books and magazines is the route to unlocking new Upgrade Branches in The Last of Us 2."

facts.fact: Ellie's four training manuals unlock skill branches for crafting, stealth, precision and explosives. The Stealth branch lets her craft silencers for her gun.
facts.quote: GamesRadar: "These focus on four core proficiencies for the character: crafting, stealth, precision, and explosives."

facts.fact: When Ellie upgrades a weapon, the camera zooms right in on her hands working on it, to make you feel her connection to her weapons.
facts.quote: PlayStation Blog: "we really zoom the camera in and show you the weapon and how she works them to improve them"

facts.fact: There are 14 safes in the game, and opening them all earns the Safecracker trophy.
facts.quote: GamesRadar: "Opening any safe will help you, but getting them all will earn you the Safecracker Trophy as well. I've got all 14 The Last of Us 2 safe codes laid out below"

facts.fact: One safe in downtown Seattle uses the code 0451, a famous door code from Deus Ex that has become a common Easter egg.
facts.quote: GamesRadar: "It's 0451, a Deus Ex reference."

facts.fact: There are 32 coins to collect, tied to American states, and there is a trophy for finding them all.
facts.quote: GamesRadar: "There are 32 Last of Us 2 coins to collect and I have them all listed here. These collectibles are tied to American states and hidden in different areas as you explore."

facts.fact: Ellie's collectible trading cards show superheroes mostly based on the developers, from a set called the Society of Champions.
facts.quote: GamesRadar: "The Last of Us 2 trading cards feature superheroes mainly based on developers"

facts.fact: One trading card, Dr. Uckmann, is a nod to Naughty Dog's Neil Druckmann and shows him as a kind of mad scientist.
facts.pairs_with: trading cards, Easter egg, Neil Druckmann
facts.quote: Push Square: "this Dr. Uckmann collectible carries special significance, seeing as it's a reference to Naughty Dog vice president Neil Druckmann."

facts.fact: In the game's world the outbreak hit in 2013, so there is no PS4. You can still find PS3 consoles in homes, some next to Uncharted 2 and Jak and Daxter.
facts.pairs_with: PS3, Easter egg, Uncharted, Jak and Daxter
facts.quote: Push Square: "Explore some households and you'll still find PlayStation 3 consoles lying around"

facts.fact: A bank in Seattle hides an engraved ring reading Sic Parvis Magna, the motto of Uncharted's Nathan Drake.
facts.quote: Screen Rant: "There's another reference to Naughty Dog's Uncharted franchise when Ellie stumbles upon an engraved ring in Westlake Bank that says "Sic Parvis Magna.""

facts.fact: A music shop in downtown Seattle has a poster for Pearl Jam's 2013 album Lightning Bolt, marked as coming soon because the outbreak hit before its release.
facts.pairs_with: music shop, Easter egg, Pearl Jam
facts.quote: GamesRadar: "In the music shop you can visit in downtown Seattle you'll see a poster for the 2013 Pearl Jam album Lightning Bolt."

facts.fact: Downtown Seattle is a semi-open world area that Ellie can explore freely, something new for the series.
facts.quote: GamesRadar: "The Last of Us 2 Downtown Seattle map represents something new for the series. It's a semi-open world which you can explore freely as Ellie"

facts.fact: In No Return, death is permanent: fail a run and you lose all weapons, items and upgrades from that run.
facts.quote: PlayStation Blog: "death is permanent in No Return, so if you fail a run midway, you'll lose all weapons, items, and upgrades accumulated for that run"

facts.fact: Between fights in No Return you go back to a Hideout and pick your next fight from a path laid out on a corkboard.
facts.quote: PlayStation Blog: "in between each combat scenario, you'll return to a Hideout, where you can prep and choose your next fight via a path laid out on a corkboard"

facts.fact: No Return has four types of encounter: Assault (waves of enemies), Capture (break into a guarded safe), Holdout (defend with an AI buddy against Infected) and Hunted (survive until the timer runs out).
facts.quote: PlayStation Blog: "No Return's challenges fall into four different types"

facts.fact: A full No Return run ends with one of six boss encounters, which unlock one after another.
facts.quote: PlayStation Blog: "you'll come up against one of six successively unlocked boss encounters"

facts.fact: One No Return mod can make Infected invisible, showing them only as shadows in your flashlight.
facts.quote: Engadget: "you might end up with one where Infected enemies are invisible, just shadows in your flashlight."

facts.fact: The Remastered version adds Lost Levels: playable sequences cut from the original game, in an early, unfinished state, with developer commentary.
facts.quote: PlayStation Blog: "A new set of Lost Levels in Part II Remastered allow players a unique chance to check out some playable sequences previously cut from the game."

facts.fact: Remastered adds a Guitar Free Play mode, where you can play unlockable instruments, use audio FX pedals, and play as different characters in several locations.
facts.quote: PlayStation Blog: "So we've introduced a new Guitar Free Play mode, which will let you strum the strings across a host of unlockable instruments, use audio FX pedals to modulate your performance, and play as different characters in several in-game locations"

facts.fact: Remastered adds new accessibility features, including Descriptive Audio and Speech to Vibrations, which uses the DualSense to show character speech and cadence.
facts.quote: PlayStation Blog: "new additions like the inclusion of Descriptive Audio and Speech to Vibrations, which uses the DualSense controller to indicate character speech and cadence."

facts.fact: Remastered's unlockable skins include one of Ellie in an astronaut suit, complete with a helmet.
facts.quote: Engadget: "including an adorable one of Ellie in an astronaut suit, complete with a helmet."

facts.fact: The Last of Us Part II won seven awards at The Game Awards 2020, including Game of the Year and the first-ever Innovation in Accessibility award.
facts.pairs_with: awards, Game of the Year, accessibility
facts.quote: VGC: "The Last of Us Part 2 was the big winner at The Game Awards 2020, taking home seven of the 10 prizes it was nominated for."
